feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 August 2026 11:56am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 18 August 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Locally strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of the British Isles, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, perhaps locally 6 in the east of the area for a time overnight. Then backing southwesterly late tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then spells of rain later this evening and overnight. Becoming mostly fair tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, gradually veering northerly overnight into Thursday, then occasionally increasing 6 in places for a time early Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Scattered showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
